verification.scope: DOM normalization permits only the declared fill attributes. All other artifact nodes and exact embedded font/photo bytes are identical. limitations: Original editorial interpretations, not measured task speed, error reduction or universal color meanings. Same palettes need not have equal visual weight after reassignment. Static fictional artifacts, not an implemented booking service, reader study, physical print proof or full accessibility evaluation.
